As the weather cools and peak season for autumn outdoor activities begins, I usually adjust my everyday carry list to match my schedule. The Pelican MagSafe Wallet and Card Holder is a top choice for those who want something rugged and durable enough for the outdoors while still functioning as a daily wallet.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers brings you the newest and best MagSafe and wireless charging products to help you get the most out of your wireless-charging-compatible Apple devices.

Top pick for outdoor activities

The Pelican Wallet carries an IPX4 water-resistance rating, meaning that even if you get splashed while on a hike or near the water, your credit cards and money stay dry. It snaps shut and stays closed. For example, in autumn I frequently attend Falcons games, and even at a football game, I want to make sure everything is tucked away and secure. That alone makes it a perfect choice for autumn outdoor activities, especially with unpredictable weather. Compared to a typical magnetic wallet that attaches to your iPhone, it's more like a small hard-shell protective case.

Most MagSafe wallets are only designed to hold a few cards. Pelican's design gives you more flexibility—you can easily fit your ID and credit cards, with room for folded bills and a small key. If you want to travel light on a hike, this wallet covers the basics without needing to bring an extra bag.

Although the Pelican Wallet is aimed at outdoor use, it works just as well as an everyday carry item. The strong magnet holds firmly to the back of your iPhone, and once it snaps shut, nothing falls out. Compared with other less-durable MagSafe wallets, this one sacrifices a bit of slimness in exchange for extra peace of mind. If I want a more minimalist wallet in summer, I might not pick it; but for hiking, watching a match, or any outdoor activity where the weather might change, it's the right choice. For kids getting their first iPhone, this MagSafe wallet is also an excellent option—my older son has been using one for several years.

Pelican MagSafe Wallet Conclusion

The Pelican MagSafe Wallet is built for people who value durability. It protects your everyday items from rain and weather, holds what you need for a hike or day trip, and snaps shut securely. If you're looking for a MagSafe wallet that can take a drop and still work great every day, this is the one.

You can buy the Pelican MagSafe Wallet directly from Amazon or the Pelican website.
